stage: MOB-02 ram production, ART-06C v03 surface; in-place presentation only

purposes.target_triangles: One evaluated runtime detail level, preserving long legs, horn openings and physical channels; automatic triangle collapse, not hand retopology.
purposes.weight_smoothing_passes: Diffuse connected skin joins while retaining rigid head/horns and hoof anchors.
purposes.stance_sink_units: Small presentation-only settling makes planted hoof targets reachable without stretching the leg bones.
purposes.breath_units: Subtle idle rib/spine rise with feet held on the floor.
purposes.step_units: Forward-to-back travel of each planted hoof in one stance; native translation remains external.
purposes.hoof_lift_units: Swing clearance above a flat support plane; no runtime terrain IK.
purposes.stance_fraction: Fraction of the gait cycle spent planted. Distance per cycle is step_units / stance_fraction.
purposes.walk_duration: Authoring speed for the four-beat gait, resampled by actual movement in the shared adapter.
purposes.windup_duration: Matches current ordinary guard windup, 0.6 seconds. Integration samples native normalized progress.
purposes.release_duration: Cosmetic short forehead follow-through/recovery after native melee release; never a damage clock.
purposes.guard_duration: Looped braced forehead pose for stationary alert presentation, not a gameplay state.
purposes.guard_neck_radians: Lower the neck moderately in the guard stance while retaining curled horn clearance.
purposes.guard_head_radians: Tilt the supported forehead toward the threat.
purposes.windup_neck_radians: Anticipation lowers the supported head before the existing melee release.
purposes.windup_head_radians: Present the forehead at native release without inventing horn contact.
purposes.strike_neck_radians: Bounded grounded follow-through; no root movement or charge.
purposes.strike_head_radians: Short skull counter-rotation during release, with horns rigidly attached.
purposes.source_fps: Dense baked bone sampling preserves fitted foot targets through interpolation.
purposes.recommended_scale: Suggested uniform metres-per-studio-unit, not a collider change; source longest dimension is two units.
purposes.body: Joints fitted to the approved uneven neck and animal torso in Blender Z-up, -Y-forward source coordinates.
purposes.legs: Four individually fitted upper/lower/pastern/hoof chains. Phase offsets make a four-beat walk.
